talk_track: Lawyers can discover the business path from the homepage, not only from hidden admin pages.
The plan page now sells an account-opening path: visibility, trust profile, measurable leads and follow-up.
Until Grow recurring approval, paid intent is captured through a compliant manual-invoice/payment-link fallback.
The lawyer does not lose the plan/payment context when continuing to registration.
The private area is visible as a product promise and routes unclaimed users back to onboarding.
Use the admin-only panel for payment-link steps, payment queue, demo-data checklist and service-request queue.
